What You'll Get

This lab analyzes your typical PMM activities and produces:

  • AI Readiness Score — How much of your work can AI assist today
  • Priority Matrix — Activities ranked by automation potential and impact
  • Tool Recommendations — Specific AI tools for each high-potential activity
  • Quick Wins — Three activities to automate this week

Takes about 10 minutes. The analysis runs in real-time.
